sections.content:
Job Title: Vice President, Service & Operations 
Location: Flexible (Remote-Friendly) 
Job Type: Full-Time 
About Mutual: Mutual Group is a dynamic and forward-thinking financial services firm dedicated to empowering registered investment advisors and financial professionals. With over four decades of excellence, we provide unique products, exceptional customer service, and innovative solutions that enable our clients to achieve their fullest potential. Our core values—Personal, Authentic, Collaborative, and Knowledgeable—guide everything we do.

sections.heading: Position Overview:
sections.content: We are seeking an experienced and visionary Vice President of Service & Operations to lead and transform our service and operations functions to support future company growth. This role requires extensive industry knowledge, technological proficiency, and a passion for data-driven decision-making. The successful candidate will collaborate closely with our current Vice President, Service & Operations, ensuring a seamless partnership in managing and enhancing all service and operations functions. Reporting directly to the Chief Operating Officer, the ideal candidate will excel in driving process improvements, leading integrations, and fostering a culture of professional excellence. This individual will also play a critical role in empowering staff, enhancing client service, and supporting the growth of our clients.

sections.heading: Key Responsibilities:
sections.content:
Leadership and Management:
Lead, manage, and hold accountable teams and directors in areas including, but not limited to, client compensation, transitions, trading, client service and brokerage operations.
Build and nurture strong relationships with employees, clients, cross-functional teams, and external partners.
Foster staff growth and development through education, training, and mentorship.
Implement change management strategies to drive continuous improvement and operational excellence.

Service and Operations Oversight:
Implement best practices in client service and support, ensuring a high level of satisfaction and engagement.
Address client service escalations and ensure timely resolution.
Implement and oversee internal training and development programs.
Oversee the management of critical client technology platforms.

Process Improvement and Innovation:
Drive execution of key business growth initiatives through process improvements and innovative methodologies.
Design, implement, and streamline operational processes to enhance efficiency and reduce costs.
Develop innovative tools and programs to support advisors and improve service delivery.
Lead integrations and ensure seamless transitions for new advisors and staff.

Project Management and Implementation:
Lead and manage multiple projects simultaneously, ensuring timely delivery and alignment with business objectives.
Develop and execute project plans, integrating data analysis, service, and support functions.
Identify and implement process improvements to enhance operational efficiency and effectiveness.

Technology and Data Proficiency:
Utilize industry technology platforms and data analysis tools to drive operational efficiency and effectiveness.
Leverage data to gather insights, inform decision-making and optimize resource allocation.

sections.heading: Qualifications:
sections.content:
Extensive operational experience in the financial services industry, preferably in a leadership role.
Proven ability to lead and manage diverse teams across multiple functions and locations.
In-depth knowledge of industry technology platforms and data analysis tools.
Strong understanding of client service best practices and support methodologies.
Exceptional project management skills with a track record of successful project delivery.
Excellent communication, interpersonal, and relationship-building skills.
Bachelor's degree in a related field; advanced degree or relevant certifications are a plus.
Relevant FINRA licenses (e.g., Series 7, 24, 66) preferred.

sections.heading: Why Join Mutual:
sections.content:
Be part of a company that values personal connections, authenticity, collaboration, and knowledge.
Competitive salary and comprehensive benefits package, including health insurance, 401k plan, generous PTO, and wellness initiatives.
Opportunities for continuous learning and professional development in a supportive and dynamic environment.

sections.heading: Application Process:
sections.content: If you meet the qualifications and are ready to take on this exciting challenge, we invite you to submit your resume and a cover letter detailing your experience and how it aligns with the responsibilities and qualifications of this role.
Join us in powering the success of advisors and transforming the financial services landscape.
